messages:
Clara (People Ops): Quick update: we've published new guidance for phased return-to-work after extended leave and clarified travel/quarantine support for employees coming back from extended international placements. Link + FAQ: https://redwood.internal/hr/return-travel-guidance :seedling:

Mina (IC): What's a phased return here? more PTO or flexible hours?

Clara (People Ops): Phased return is a flexible schedule option for up to 8 weeks where employees can reduce weekly hours (50%-90%) while keeping full benefits and role protections. Its available after any paid parental, medical, or caregiver leave of 4+ weeks. It's not additional PTO  it's a temporary schedule adjustment with manager approval.

Owen (Manager): Manager approval process? documentation?

Clara (People Ops): Submit the Phased Return request form (link in doc). Manager confirms team coverage and sets a check-in cadence. People Ops will provision the payroll adjustment (if any) and set an automatic 2-week check-in reminder. No extra legal forms unless it's ADA-related (then HR/Legal looped in).

Sam (Finance): Any payroll codes or benefits change?

Clara (People Ops): Payroll code: RETURN-FLEX for tracking. Benefits remain active; if hours drop below 30/week long-term well review benefits eligibility with you before week 9. Any wellbeing stipend used during return (e.g., childcare support) should use RETURN-WELL on expenses. Finance: please auto-expedite these.

Leah (People Ops): Travel/quarantine support: for employees returning from international caregiving placements, we now provide a one-time rapid-test kit reimbursement (up to $60) and an optional travel day buffer (up to 3 paid days) to handle quarantine or care transitions. Use expense codes MED-TEST and RETURN-DAY.

Diego (Security): Does the travel buffer apply if local rules require quarantine?

Clara (People Ops): Yes. If local law or medical guidance requires self-isolation on return, the buffer covers up to 3 paid business days. For longer medically-required isolation, apply for Emergency Relocation/Leave or Medical Leave per existing policies.

Raj (IC): Are contractors eligible for the return buffer and test kit?

Clara (People Ops): Contractors with active contracts of 12+ weeks can get the rapid-test reimbursement (MED-TEST) but not the paid return buffer. We included examples in the FAQ.

Mina (IC): Any code-of-conduct notes for returning from high-risk locations?

Diego (Security): Reminder: if youve been in an area with known safety concerns, follow the Travel Safety Pledge steps, report incidents, and avoid client meetings until cleared. People Ops and Security will coordinate any necessary temporary work adjustments.

hr-bot: Policy updated: https://redwood.internal/hr/return-travel-guidance. Office hours: Fri 9am PT drop-in and 3pm PT screening slots for managers.

Owen (Manager): Thanks  useful. I'll share with my team leads and add the form to our onboarding checklist for returning teammates.

Clara (People Ops): Thanks everyone. If you want us to fast-track a phased return for someone coming back this week, DM me and we'll prioritize. :handshake:
